G3880.strongs: to receive near, i.e. associate with oneself (in any familiar or intimate act or relation); by analogy, to assume an office; figuratively, to learn
senses: with accusative of thing(s), like παραδέχομαι, correl. to παραδίδωμι, to receive from another: [[r:COL.4.17|Col 4:17]], [[r:HEB.12.28|Heb 12:28]]; of the mind, [[r:1CO.11.23|1Co 11:23 15:1 15:3]], [[r:GAL.1.9|Gal 1:9]], [[r:PHP.4.9|Php 4:9]]; with inf., [[r:MRK.7.4|Mrk 7:4]]; before παρά, with gem, [[r:GAL.1.12|Gal 1:12]], [[r:1TH.2.13|1Th 2:13 4:1]], [[r:2TH.3.6|2Th 3:6]]; τ. Χριστόν (Lft., in l), [[r:COL.2.6|Col 2:6.]]

C. accusative of person(s), to take to or with oneself: [[r:MAT.2.13|Mat 2:13-14, 20-21 17:1 26:37]], [[r:MRK.4.36|Mrk 4:36 5:40 9:2 10:32]], [[r:LUK.9.10|Luk 9:10, 28 11:26 18:31 19:16]], [[r:ACT.15.39|Act 15:39 23:18]]; γυναῖκα, [[r:MAT.1.20|Mat 1:20, 24]]; μεθ᾽ ἑαυτοῦ, [[r:MAT.12.45|Mat 12:45 18:16]], [[r:MRK.14.33|Mrk 14:33]]; before εἰς, [[r:MAT.4.5|Mat 4:5, 8 27:27]]; κατ᾽ ἰδίαν, [[r:MAT.20.17|Mat 20:17]]; mid., before πρὸς ἐμαυτόν, [[r:JHN.14.3|Jhn 14:3]]; pass., [[r:MAT.24.40|Mat 24:40-41]], [[r:LUK.17.34|Luk 17:34-36]]; ptcp., prefixed to other verbs (Bl, § 74, 2), [[r:ACT.16.33|Act 16:33 21:24, 26 21:32]]; metaphorically, [[r:JHN.1.11|Jhn 1:11.]]† (AS)

G3854.strongs: to become near, i.e. approach (have arrived); by implication, to appear publicly
senses: to be beside or at hand (Hom., Hdt., al.), hence, to stand by, sup­port (Æsch., Thuc., al.): with dative of person(s), [[r:2TI.4.16|2Ti 4:16.]]

to come, come up, arrive (Hdt., Xen., al., and frequently in later writers; see MM, xviii; Thackeray, Gr., 267.2): absol., [[r:LUK.14.21|Luk 14:21 19:16]], [[r:JHN.3.23|Jhn 3:23]], [[r:ACT.5.21|Act 5:21-22, 25 9:39 10:32-33 11:23 14:27 17:10 18:27 21:18 23:16, 35 24:17, 24 25:7 28:21]], [[r:1CO.16.3|1Co 16:3]]; before εἰς, [[r:JHN.8.2|Jhn 8:2]], [[r:ACT.9.26|Act 9:26 15:4]]; ἐπί, with accusative, [[r:LUK.22.52|Luk 22:52]]; πρός, with accusative, [[r:LUK.7.4|Luk 7:4, 20 8:19]], [[r:ACT.20.18|Act 20:18]]; id. before ἐκ, [[r:LUK.11.6|Luk 11:6]]; παρά, with genitive, [[r:MRK.14.43|Mrk 14:43]]; ἀπὸ... εἰς, [[r:MAT.2.1|Mat 2:1]], [[r:ACT.13.14|Act 13:14]]; ἀπὸ... ἐπὶ... πρός, [[r:MAT.3.13|Mat 3:13]]; of a teacher coming forward in public: [[r:MAT.3.1|Mat 3:1]], [[r:LUK.12.51|Luk 12:51]], [[r:HEB.9.11|Heb 9:11]].† (AS)

G3844.forms: παρά, prep. with genitive, dative, accusative
G3844.strongs: properly, near; i.e. (with genitive case) from beside (literally or figuratively), (with dative case) at (or in) the vicinity of (objectively or subjectively), (with accusative case) to the proximity with (local (especially beyond or opposed to) or causal (on account of)
G3844.kjv: above, against, among, at, before, by, contrary to, X friend, from, + give (such things as they), + that (she) had, X his, in, more than, nigh unto, (out) of, past, save, side…by, in the sight of, than, (there-)fore, with
senses: C. genitive of person(s), from the side of, from beside, from, indicating source or origin, after verbs of motion, [[r:MRK.14.43|Mrk 14:43]], [[r:LUK.8.49|Luk 8:49]], [[r:JHN.15.26|Jhn 15:26]], al.; after verbs of seeking, receiving, hearing, etc., [[r:MRK.8.11|Mrk 8:11 12:2]], [[r:JHN.4.9|Jhn 4:9, 52 10:18]], [[r:PHP.4.18|Php 4:18]], [[r:2TI.1.18|2Ti 1:18]], [[r:JAS.1.7|Jas 1:7]], al.; after passive verbs, of the agent (like ὑπό), [[r:MAT.21.42|Mat 21:42]], [[r:MRK.12.11|Mrk 12:11]], [[r:LUK.1.37|Luk 1:37]]; absol., οἱ παρ᾽ αὐτοῦ, his family, his kinsfolk, [[r:MRK.3.21|Mrk 3:21]] (cf. M, Pr., 106f.; Field, Notes, 25f.; Swete, in l.); τὰ παρ᾽ αὐτῆς (αὐτῶν, ὑμῶν, one's means, wealth, [[r:MRK.5.26|Mrk 5:26]], [[r:LUK.10.7|Luk 10:7]], [[r:PHP.4.18|Php 4:18]].

C. dative of person(s) (exc. [[r:JHN.19.25|Jhn 19:25]], π. τ. σταυρῷ), by the side of, beside, by, with, [[r:LUK.11.37|Luk 11:37 19:7]], [[r:JHN.1.40|Jhn 1:40 4:40]], [[r:ACT.28.14|Act 28:14]], al.; παρ᾽ ἑαυτῷ, at home, [[r:1CO.16.2|1Co 16:2]]; with dative pl., among, [[r:MAT.22.25|Mat 22:25]], [[r:COL.4.16|Col 4:16]], al.; metaphorically, [[r:MAT.19.26|Mat 19:26]], [[r:MRK.10.27|Mrk 10:27]], [[r:LUK.1.30|Luk 1:30]], [[r:ROM.2.13|Rom 2:13]], [[r:JAS.1.27|Jas 1:27]], al.
C. accusative, of motion by or towards,

of place, by the side of, beside, by, along: [[r:ACT.10.32|Act 10:32]], [[r:HEB.11.12|Heb 11:12]]; after verbs of motion, [[r:MAT.4.18|Mat 4:18]], [[r:MRK.4.4|Mrk 4:4]], [[r:LUK.8.5|Luk 8:5]], [[r:ACT.4.35|Act 4:35]], al.; after verbs of rest, [[r:MAT.13.1|Mat 13:1]], [[r:MRK.5.21|Mrk 5:21]], [[r:LUK.8.35|Luk 8:35]], al.
beyond, above, in comparison with: [[r:LUK.3.13|Luk 3:13]], [[r:ROM.12.3|Rom 12:3 14:5]], [[r:HEB.1.4|Heb 1:4, 9 3:3]], al.; (with) on account of: [[r:1CO.12.15|1Co 12:15, 16]].
In composition: beside, to (παραλαμβάνω, παράγω), at hand (πάρειμι), from (παραρρέω), amiss (παρακούω), past (παρέρχομαι), compared with (παρομοιάζω), above measure (παροργίζω). (AS)

G3813.strongs: a childling (of either sex), i.e. (properly), an infant, or (by extension) a half-grown boy or girl; figuratively, an immature Christian

G3816.strongs: a boy (as often beaten with impunity), or (by analogy), a girl, and (genitive case) a child; specially, a slave or servant (especially a minister to a king; and by eminence to God)
G3816.kjv: child, maid(-en), (man) servant, son, young man
senses: a child, boy, youth, maiden: ὁ π., [[r:MAT.17.18|Mat 17:18]], [[r:LUK.2.43|Luk 2:43 9:42]], [[r:ACT.20.12|Act 20:12]]; ἡ π. [[r:LUK.8.51|Luk 8:51, 54]] (on the artic. fern, of address, see M, Pr., 70 f., 235; B1., § 33, 4); pl., [[r:MAT.2.16|Mat 2:16 21:15]]; of parentage, with genitive, [[r:JHN.4.51|Jhn 4:51]]

Like Heb. עֶבֶד, Lat. Auer, Fr. garcon, Eng. boy (Æsch., Aristoph., Xen., al.), servant, slave, attendant: [[r:MAT.8.6|Mat 8:6, 8 8:13]] [[r:LUK.7.7|Luk 7:7 12:45 15:26]]; in late writers (Diod., LXX: [[r:GEN.41.37|Gen 41:37]], al.), of a king's attendant or minister: [[r:MAT.14.2|Mat 14:2]]; so (= Heb. יְהוָֹה עֶבֶד) π. τ. θεοῦ ([[r:PSA.69.18|Psa 69:18]], [[r:ISA.41.8|Isa 41:8]], [[r:WIS.2.13|Wis 2:13]], al.), of Israel, [[r:LUK.1.54|Luk 1:54]]; of David, [[r:LUK.1.69|Luk 1:69]], [[r:ACT.4.25|Act 4:25]]; of Jesus (but see Dalman, Words, 277 f.), [[r:MAT.12.18|Mat 12:18]] (LXX), [[r:ACT.3.13|Act 3:13, 26 4:27, 30]].† SYN.:

τέκνον, child, with emphasis on parentage and the consequent community of nature; υἱός, son, with emphasis on the privileged position of heirship; π. refers both to age and parentage, but with emphasis on the former. Cf. also (παιδάριον), (παιδίον), (παιδίσκη), and see Westc. on [[r:1JN.3.1|1Jn 3:1.]]
see: θεράπων, and cf. Thackeray, Gr., 7 f (AS)

G3870.strongs: to call near, i.e. invite, invoke (by imploration, hortation or consolation)
G3870.kjv: beseech, call for, (be of good) comfort, desire, (give) exhort(-ation), intreat, pray
senses: to call to one, call for, summon: [[r:ACT.28.20|Act 28:20]] (R, mg.; R, txt., entreat); hence (of the gods: Dem., Xen., al.), to invoke, call on, beseech, entreat: τ. πατέρα μου, [[r:MAT.26.53|Mat 26:53]]; τ. κύριον, [[r:2CO.12.8|2Co 12:8]]; in late writers (Polyb., Diod., al.; rarely in LXX; in π., see Deiss., LAE, 176.14), also of men: absol., Phm 9; with accusative, [[r:MAT.8.5|Mat 8:5]], [[r:MRK.1.40|Mrk 1:40]], [[r:ACT.16.9|Act 16:9]], al.; with inf., [[r:MRK.5.17|Mrk 5:17]], [[r:LUK.8.41|Luk 8:41]], [[r:ACT.8.31|Act 8:31]], al.; before ἵνα (see M, Pr., 205, 208), Mt 14"36, [[r:MRK.5.18|Mrk 5:18]], Luk 8:31, al.

to cheer, encourage, comfort (Plut., LXX: Jb 43, [[r:ISA.35.3|Isa 35:3]], [[r:SIR.43.24|Sir 43:24]], al.): with accusative, [[r:2CO.1.6|2Co 1:6]], [[r:EPH.6.22|Eph 6:22]], [[r:COL.2.2|Col 2:2]], al.; id. before ἐν, [[r:1TH.4.18|1Th 4:18]]; διά, [[r:2CO.1.4|2Co 1:4]]; pass., [[r:MAT.5.4|Mat 5:4]], [[r:LUK.16.25|Luk 16:25]], [[r:ACT.20.12|Act 20:12]]. SYN.: παραμυθέω (cf. M, Th., 25). (AS)

G3825.root: probably from the same as [[w:G3823]] (through the idea of oscillatory repetition)
G3825.strongs: (adverbially) anew, i.e. (of place) back, (of time) once more, or (conjunctionally) furthermore or on the other hand
senses: Of time, again, once more: [[r:MAT.4.8|Mat 4:8]], [[r:MRK.2.13|Mrk 2:13]], [[r:LUK.23.20|Luk 23:20]], [[r:JHN.1.35|Jhn 1:35]] (and freq.), [[r:ACT.17.32|Act 17:32]], [[r:ROM.11.23|Rom 11:23]], [[r:GAL.1.9|Gal 1:9]], [[r:HEB.1.6|Heb 1:6]], al; pleonastically, π. ἀνακάμπτειν, [[r:ACT.18.21|Act 18:21]]; ὑποστρέφειν, [[r:GAL.1.17|Gal 1:17]]; εἰς τὸ π., [[r:2CO.13.2|2Co 13:2]]; π. ἐκ τρίτου (Bl., §81, 4), [[r:MAT.26.44|Mat 26:44]]; ἐκ δευτέρου, [[r:MAT.26.42|Mat 26:42]], [[r:ACT.10.15|Act 10:15]]; π. δεῦτερον, [[r:JHN.4.54|Jhn 4:54 21:16]]; π. ἄνωθεν ( [[r:WIS.19.6|Wis 19:6]]), [[r:GAL.4.9|Gal 4:9]].

G3860.strongs: to surrender, i.e yield up, intrust, transmit
G3860.kjv: betray, bring forth, cast, commit, deliver (up), give (over, up), hazard, put in prison, recommend
senses: to give or hand over to another: with accusative and dative, [[r:MAT.11.27|Mat 11:27 25:14]], [[r:LUK.4.6|Luk 4:6]], al.; of being delivered up to a course of teaching, pass. before εἰς, [[r:ROM.6.17|Rom 6:17.]]

to give or deliver up to prison or judgment: with accusative of person(s), [[r:MAT.4.12|Mat 4:12]], [[r:MRK.1.14|Mrk 1:14]], [[r:ROM.4.25|Rom 4:25]], [[r:2PE.2.4|2Pe 2:4]]; id. before ὑπέρ, [[r:ROM.8.32|Rom 8:32]]; with dative, [[r:MAT.5.25|Mat 5:25]], [[r:MRK.15.1|Mrk 15:1]], [[r:LUK.12.58|Luk 12:58]], [[r:JHN.19.11|Jhn 19:11]], al.; id. before ἵνα, [[r:JHN.19.16|Jhn 19:16]]; with inf., [[r:ACT.12.4|Act 12:4]]; before εἰς, [[r:MAT.10.17|Mat 10:17 17:22 24:9]], [[r:LUK.21.12|Luk 21:12]], [[r:ACT.8.3|Act 8:3]], [[r:2CO.4.11|2Co 4:11]], al.; τ. Σατανᾷ, [[r:1TI.1.20|1Ti 1:20]]; id. before εἰς, [[r:1CO.5.5|1Co 5:5]]; with the collat. idea of treachery (= προδίδωμι), with accusative of person(s), [[r:MAT.26.25|Mat 26:25]], [[r:MRK.14.11|Mrk 14:11]], [[r:JHN.6.64|Jhn 6:64]], al.; id. with dative, [[r:MAT.26.15|Mat 26:15]], al.; present ptcp., ὁ παραδιδοὺς, [[r:MAT.26.25|Mat 26:25]], [[r:MRK.14.42|Mrk 14:42]], [[r:JHN.13.11|Jhn 13:11]].

to hand down, hand on or deliver verbally (traditions, commands, etc.): [[r:MRK.7.13|Mrk 7:13]], [[r:LUK.1.2|Luk 1:2]], [[r:ACT.6.14|Act 6:14]], [[r:1CO.11.2|1Co 11:2 15:2]]; pass., [[r:2PE.2.21|2Pe 2:21]], Ju 3.
to permit (for exx. in cl., see LS, see word): [[r:MRK.4.29|Mrk 4:29.]] (AS)

G3855.strongs: to lead near, i.e. (reflexively or intransitively) to go along or away
senses: trans., to lead by, lead aside, lead into, lead forward, etc.
to pass by: [[r:MAT.9.9|Mat 9:9, 27 20:30]], [[r:MRK.2.14|Mrk 2:14 15:21]], [[r:JHN.8.59|Jhn 8:59]] R, txt., [[r:JHN.9.1|Jhn 9:1]]; before παρό, with accusative, [[r:MRK.1.16|Mrk 1:16]];
to go away, depart; metaphorically, to pass away: [[r:1CO.7.31|1Co 7:31]]; mid., [[r:1JN.2.8|1Jn 2:8]] [[r:JHN.2.17|Jn 2:17]].† (AS)

G3820.strongs: antique, i.e. not recent, worn out
senses: (πάλαι), old, ancient; opposite to νέος, καινός: οἶνος, [[r:LUK.5.3|Luk 5:3]]; διαθήκη, [[r:2CO.3.14|2Co 3:14]]; ἐντολή, [[r:1JN.2.7|1Jn 2:7]]; ζύμη, [[r:1CO.5.7|1Co 5:7-8]]; ὁ π. ἄςθρωπος (for similar phrases, see Westc., Eph., 68), [[r:ROM.6.6|Rom 6:6]], [[r:EPH.4.22|Eph 4:22]], [[r:COL.3.9|Col 3:9]]; neut. pl., καινὰ καὶ π., [[r:MAT.13.52|Mat 13:52]]; of things not merely old, but worn by use (as Jo, l.with, LXX), [[r:MAT.9.16|Mat 9:16-17]], [[r:MRK.2.21|Mrk 2:21-22]], [[r:LUK.5.36|Luk 5:36-37]].† SYN.: see: ἀρχαῖος (AS)

G3853.strongs: to transmit a message, i.e. (by implication) to enjoin
senses: to order, command (Hdt., Xen., al.): with inf., [[r:ACT.15.5|Act 15:5]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:1CO.11.17|1Co 11:17]], [[r:2TH.3.4|2Th 3:4]], [[r:1TI.4.11|1Ti 4:11 5:7]]; before ἵνα (M, Pr., 207; Bl., § 69, 4), [[r:MRK.6.8|Mrk 6:8]], [[r:2TH.3.12|2Th 3:12]]; with dative of person(s), [[r:ACT.17.30|Act 17:30]] R, txt., [[r:1TH.4.11|1Th 4:11]]; before λέγων, [[r:MAT.10.5|Mat 10:5]]; with inf. aor., [[r:MAT.15.35|Mat 15:35]], [[r:MRK.8.6|Mrk 8:6]], [[r:LUK.8.29|Luk 8:29]], [[r:ACT.10.42|Act 10:42 16:18]] (aoristic pres.; see M, Pr., 119); id. with neg., μή, [[r:LUK.5.14|Luk 5:14 8:56]], [[r:ACT.23.22|Act 23:22]], [[r:1CO.7.10|1Co 7:10]]; with inf. pres., [[r:ACT.16.23|Act 16:23]], [[r:2TH.3.6|2Th 3:6]]; id. with neg., ιή, [[r:LUK.9.21|Luk 9:21]], [[r:ACT.1.4|Act 1:4 4:18 5:28, 40]], [[r:1TI.1.3|1Ti 1:3 6:17]]; with accusative, τοῦτο, before ὅτι (E1., § 70, 3), [[r:2TH.3.10|2Th 3:10]]; with accusative and inf., [[r:ACT.23.30|Act 23:30]], [[r:2TH.3.6|2Th 3:6]], [[r:1TI.6.13|1Ti 6:13]] (Bl., § 72, 5).† SYN.: see: ἐντέλλω (AS)

G3819.root: probably another form for [[w:G3825]] (through the idea of retrocession)
G3819.strongs: (adverbially) formerly, or (by relatively) sometime since; (elliptically as adjective) ancient
G3819.kjv: any while, a great while ago, (of) old, in time past
senses: πάλαι adv. of time, long ago, of old, in time past (denoting past time absolutely, as πρότερον relatively): [[r:MAT.11.21|Mat 11:21]], [[r:LUK.10.13|Luk 10:13]], [[r:HEB.1.1|Heb 1:1]], Ju 4; as adj., with art., [[r:2PE.1.9|2Pe 1:9]]; of time just past, [[r:MRK.6.47|Mrk 6:47]] (WH, mg.), [[r:MRK.15.44|Mrk 15:44]] (WH, mg., R, txt.); with durst. praes. (RV, all this time), [[r:2CO.12.19|2Co 12:19.]]† (AS)

G3850.strongs: a similitude ("parable"), i.e. (symbolic) fictitious narrative (of common life conveying a moral), apothegm or adage
senses: a comparison, illustration, analogy, figure (Arist., al.): [[r:MAT.24.32|Mat 24:32]], [[r:MRK.3.23|Mrk 3:23]], [[r:HEB.9.9|Heb 9:9 11:19]]; specif. of the pictures and narratives drawn from nature and human life which are characteristic of the synoptic teaching of our Lord, a parable: [[r:MAT.13.3|Mat 13:3, 10]] [[r:MRK.4.2|Mrk 4:2, 10]], [[r:LUK.8.4|Luk 8:4, 9-11]], al.; with genitive ref., [[r:MAT.13.18|Mat 13:18, 36]]

4 Like Heb. מָשַׁל ([[r:1KI.10.12|1Ki 10:12]], [[r:PRO.1.6|Pro 1:6]], [[r:SIR.3.29|Sir 3:29]], al.), = παροιμία, a proverb or gnomic saying: [[r:LUK.4.23|Luk 4:23 5:36 6:39]] SYN.: παροιμία (see Abbott, Essays, 82 ff.) (AS)

G3845.strongs: to go contrary to, i.e. violate a command
senses: in Hom. (twice), to go by the side of, stand beside.

In Æsch., Herod., Thuc., al., to go past or pass over, chiefly metaphorically, to overstep, violate, transgress ([[r:JOS.7.11|Jos 7:11]], [[r:EZK.16.59|Eze 16:59]], [[r:SIR.40.14|Sir 40:14]], al.): τ. παράδοσιν, [[r:MAT.15.2|Mat 15:2]]; τ. ἐντολήν, [[r:MAT.15.3|Mat 15:3]]; before ἀπό (as מִן סוּר, [[r:DEU.17.20|Deu 17:20]], al.), to turn aside, fall away (cf. π. τῆς ἀληθείας, Arist., Cael., i, 5, 2): [[r:ACT.1.25|Act 1:25.]]† (AS)

G3862.strongs: transmission, i.e. (concretely) a precept; specially, the Jewish traditionary law
senses: a handing down or over, transfer, transmission (Arist., Polyb., al., LXX).

tradition of doctrine (Plat., Epict., al.); by meton., of the doctrine itself: [[r:MAT.15.2|Mat 15:2-3]], 6, [[r:MRK.7.3|Mrk 7:3]], [[r:1CO.11.2|1Co 11:2]], [[r:GAL.1.14|Gal 1:14]], [[r:COL.2.8|Col 2:8]], [[r:2TH.2.15|2Th 2:15 3:9]].† (AS)

G3878.strongs: to mishear, i.e. (by implication) to disobey
senses: Later (as in LXX, Polyb., Plut.; also in π., see MM, xviii), to hear without heeding, take no heed: [[r:MRK.5.36|Mrk 5:36]]; with genitive, [[r:MAT.18.17|Mat 18:17.]]† (AS)

G3824.strongs: (spiritual) rebirth (the state or the act), i.e. (figuratively) spiritual renovation; specially, Messianic restoration
senses: παλινγενεσία (Rec. παλιγγ-), -ας, ἡ (πάλιν, γενεσις), new birth, renewal, restoration, regeneration;
of persons (Plut., Phil., al.), of spiritual regeneration, διὰ λουτροῦ παλινγενεστίας (genitive attr., see Ellic., in l), [[r:TIT.3.5|Tit 3:5]];
of the world, as in Stoics, Jewish Apocal., al. (see Dalman, Words, 177 ff.), [[r:MAT.19.28|Mat 19:28.]]† (AS)
(παγίς), to ensnare: metaphorically, with accusative, ἐν λόγῳ, [[r:MAT.22.15|Mat 22:15]] (not elsewhere).† (AS)

G3842.strongs: every when, i.e. at all times
senses: πάντοτε adv. of time (πᾶς), in late writers (once in Arist.) for διαπαντός, ἑκάστοτε, at all times, always: [[r:MAT.26.11|Mat 26:11]], [[r:MRK.14.7|Mrk 14:7]], [[r:LUK.15.31|Luk 15:31]], [[r:JHN.6.34|Jhn 6:34]], [[r:ROM.1.10|Rom 1:10]], and frequently in Paul. Epp (AS)

G3817.strongs: to hit (as if by a single blow and less violently than); specially, to sting (as a scorpion)
senses: παίω to strike, smite: with the hand or fist, [[r:MAT.26.68|Mat 26:68]], [[r:LUK.22.64|Luk 22:64]]; with a sword, [[r:MRK.14.47|Mrk 14:47]], [[r:JHN.18.10|Jhn 18:10]]; of a reptile, to sting: [[r:REV.9.5|Rev 9:5.]]† (AS)

G3814.strongs: a girl, i.e. (specially), a female slave or servant
senses: Colloq., a young female slave, a maid-servant (see Kennedy, Sources, 40 f.; Deiss., LAE, 186, 332.2): [[r:MAT.26.69|Mat 26:69]], [[r:MRK.14.66|Mrk 14:66, 69]], [[r:LUK.12.45|Luk 12:45 22:56]], [[r:JHN.18.17|Jhn 18:17]], [[r:ACT.12.13|Act 12:13 16:16]]; of Hagar, [[r:GAL.4.22|Gal 4:22-23, 30]]" (LXX); id., metaphorically, [[r:GAL.4.31|Gal 4:31.]]† SYN.: see: παῖς (AS)
to go past, pass by: [[r:MAT.27.39|Mat 27:39]], [[r:MRK.11.20|Mrk 11:20 15:29]]; before διά, with genitive, [[r:MRK.2.23|Mrk 2:23 9:30]] (WH, mg.).† (AS)

G3837.root: genitive case (as adverb of place) of a presumed derivative of [[w:G3956]]

G3858.strongs: to accept near, i.e. admit or (by implication) delight in

G3868.root: from [[w:G3844]] and the middle voice of [[w:G0154]]
G3868.strongs: to beg off, i.e. deprecate, decline, shun
senses: to beg of or from another: [[r:MRK.15.6|Mrk 15:6]] (Rec. ὅνπερ ᾐτοῦντο, see Field, Notes, 43).
prop., with neg., to entreat that not (Thuc., al.): [[r:HEB.12.19|Heb 12:19]];
to refuse, decline, avoid: o. accusative, [[r:1TI.4.7|1Ti 4:7 5:11]], [[r:2TI.2.23|2Ti 2:23]], [[r:TIT.3.10|Tit 3:10]], [[r:HEB.12.25|Heb 12:25]] (EV; but see Field, Notes, 234).
to beg off, ask to be excused, excuse (Polyb., al.): [[r:LUK.14.18|Luk 14:18-19]] ([[r:HEB.12.25|Heb 12:25]], Field, l.with).† (AS)

G3877.strongs: to follow near, i.e. (figuratively) attend (as a result), trace out, conform to
G3877.kjv: attain, follow, fully know, have understanding
senses: παρ-ακολουθέω, -ῶ with dative, to follow closely, accompany. Metaphorical, in various senses,

to follow up, trace, investigate: [[r:LUK.1.3|Luk 1:3]] (so frequently in cl.); (with) to follow as a standard of conduct: [[r:1TI.4.6|1Ti 4:6]], [[r:2TI.3.10|2Ti 3:10]]. (For exx. from π., see MM, xviii.)† (AS)
a calling to one's aid, summons (Thus.), hence, appeal, entreaty (Strab., Plut., al., [[r:1MA.10.24|1Ma 10:24]]; of. Lft., Notes, 20): [[r:2CO.8.4|2Co 8:4.]]

consolation, comfort (Phalar., LXX): [[r:LUK.6.24|Luk 6:24]], [[r:ACT.9.31|Act 9:31]], [[r:2CO.1.4|2Co 1:4-7 7:4 7:7 7:13]], [[r:2TH.2.16|2Th 2:16]], Phm 7; τ. γραφῶν, [[r:ROM.15.4|Rom 15:4]]; θεὸς τῆς π., [[r:ROM.15.5|Rom 15:5]], [[r:2CO.1.3|2Co 1:3]]; π. τοῦ Ἰσραήλ (see Dalman, Words, 109 f.), Lk (AS)

G3800.root: neuter of a presumed derivative of the same as [[w:G3795]]
G3800.strongs: rations for a soldier, i.e. (by extension) his stipend or pay
senses: Generally, wages, hire: [[r:2CO.11.8|2Co 11:8]]; ὄ. τῆς ἁμαρτίας, [[r:ROM.6.23|Rom 6:23]] (see Deiss, BS, 148, 266).† (AS)

G3843.strongs: entirely; specially, at all events, (with negative, following) in no event
G3843.kjv: by all means, altogether, at all, needs, no doubt, in (no) wise, surely
senses: without neg. (from Hdt. on): [[r:1CO.16.12|1Co 16:12]]; esp. in strong affirmations, surely, at all events: [[r:LUK.4.23|Luk 4:23]], [[r:ACT.21.22|Act 21:22 28:4]], [[r:1CO.9.10|1Co 9:10]];
with neg. (so always in mom.), in a complete negation: [[r:ROM.3.9|Rom 3:9]]; in a partial negation (Bl., § 75, 7), [[r:1CO.5.10|1Co 5:10.]]† (AS)

G3886.strongs: to loosen beside, i.e. relax (perfect passive participle, paralyzed or enfeebled)
G3886.kjv: feeble, sick of the (taken with) palsy
senses: to loose from the side, set free.
to weaken, enfeeble; pass., to be en­feebled, esp. by a paralytic stroke: [[r:LUK.5.18|Luk 5:18, 24]], [[r:ACT.8.7|Act 8:7 9:33]], [[r:HEB.12.12|Heb 12:12]]" (LXX).† (AS)

G3861.root: from [[w:G3844]] and [[w:G1391]] (in the sense of seeming)
senses: (παρά, δόξα), contrary to received opinion, incredible, marvellous: pl., [[r:LUK.5.26|Luk 5:26.]]† SYN.: see: δύναμις (AS)

παρ-άλιος, -ον (in cl., chiefly -α, -ον), by the sea; ἡ π. (sc. χώρα, in LXX ἡ παραλία, [[r:DEU.1.7|Deu 1:7]], [[r:JOS.9.1|Jos 9:1]], [[r:JDT.1.7|Jdth.1:7]], al.), the sea coast: [[r:LUK.6.17|Luk 6:17.]]† (AS)
παρα-καλύπτω to cover by hanging something beside, to hide: metaphorically (as Plat., al.), [[r:LUK.9.45|Luk 9:45.]]† (AS)

G3829.root: neuter of a presumed compound of [[w:G3956]] and a derivative of [[w:G1209]]
G3829.strongs: all-receptive, i.e. a public lodging-place (caravanserai or khan)
senses: παν-δοχεῖον (-δοκίον, Τ), -ου, τό (πανδοχεύς), late form of Att.. πανδοκεῖον, an inn (khân, caravanserai): [[r:LUK.10.34|Luk 10:34.]]† (AS)
παν-δοχεύς, -έως, ὁ (πᾶς, δέχομαι), late form of the Att.. πανδοκεύς (T, in l), an innkeeper, host: [[r:LUK.10.35|Luk 10:35.]]† (AS)
παρα-καθίζω to set beside; act. for mid., to sit down beside: [[r:LUK.10.39|Luk 10:39]], Rec. (for -έζομαι, which see).† (AS)
(πᾶς, ὅπλον) full armour: [[r:LUK.11.22|Luk 11:22]]; metaphorically (cf. Wis, l.with), τ. θεοῦ, [[r:EPH.6.11|Eph 6:11, 13]] † (AS)

G3822.strongs: to make (passively, become) worn out, or declare obsolete
senses: (παλαιός), to make or declare old: [[r:HEB.8.13|Heb 8:13]]; pass., to become old: of things worn out by time and use (cf. [[r:JHN.9.13|Jhn 9:13]], [[r:ISA.50.9|Isa 50:9]], al., and see: παλαιός), [[r:LUK.12.33|Luk 12:33]], [[r:HEB.1.11|Heb 1:11]]" (LXX); τὸ παλαιούμενον, [[r:HEB.8.13|Heb 8:13]] (where this and the act., see supr., may have the sense of abrogate, see LS, Zorell, see word).† SYN.: γηράσκω (AS)

G3838.strongs: full-ended, i.e. entire (neuter as noun, completion)
senses: (πᾶς, τέλος), all-complete, entire, perfect; εἰς τ. παντελές, completely, utterly: [[r:LUK.13.11|Luk 13:11]], [[r:HEB.7.25|Heb 7:25]] (where perhaps in temp. sense, finally; see MM, xviii).† (AS)

G3834.strongs: adroitness, i.e. (in a bad sense) trickery or sophistry
senses: (πανοῦργος), cleverness, in cl. nearly always in bad sense, craftiness, cunning, knavery: [[r:LUK.20.23|Luk 20:23]], [[r:1CO.3.19|1Co 3:19]] (LXX, φρόνησις, for עׇרְמָה) [[r:2CO.4.2|2Co 4:2 11:3]], [[r:EPH.4.14|Eph 4:14]].† (AS)

G3803.strongs: a trap (as fastened by a noose or notch); figuratively, a trick or statagem (temptation)
senses: (πήγνυμι), poët. (Aristoph., al.) and late for πάγη, a trap, snare; metaphorically (as also in cl.): [[r:LUK.21.35|Luk 21:35]], [[r:ROM.11.9|Rom 11:9]]" (LXX) [[r:1TI.3.7|1Ti 3:7 6:9]], [[r:2TI.2.26|2Ti 2:26]].† (AS)

G3811.strongs: to train up a child, i.e. educate, or (by implication), discipline (by punishment)
senses: as in cl., to train children, hence, generally, to teach, instruct: [[r:ACT.7.22|Act 7:22 22:3]], [[r:1TI.1.20|1Ti 1:20]], [[r:TIT.2.12|Tit 2:12]].

As in LXX ([[r:PSA.6.2|Psa 6:2]], [[r:PRO.19.18|Pro 19:18]], [[r:WIS.3.5|Wis 3:5]], al., and for prob. ex. from π., see MM, xviii), to chasten, correct, chastise: [[r:LUK.23.16|Luk 23:16, 22]], [[r:2TI.2.25|2Ti 2:25]], [[r:HEB.12.7|Heb 12:7, 10]]; of divine chastening, [[r:1CO.11.32|1Co 11:32]], [[r:2CO.6.9|2Co 6:9]], [[r:HEB.12.6|Heb 12:6]], [[r:REV.3.19|Rev 3:19]].† SYN.: διδάσκω, q.v (AS)

G3826.root: dative case (adverb) of a compound of [[w:G3956]] and [[w:G4128]]
G3826.strongs: in full multitude, i.e. concertedly or simultaneously
senses: πανπληθεί (Rec. παμπλ-, see WH, App., 150), adv. (πᾶς, πλῆθος), = cl. παμπληθές, with the whole multitude, all together: [[r:LUK.23.18|Luk 23:18.]]† (AS)

G3857.strongs: a park, i.e. (specially), an Eden (place of future happiness, "paradise")
senses: (an Oriental word, first used by Xen. of the parks of Persian kings and nobles)
a park, pleasure-ground, garden (LXX), an orchard (in π., see MM, ii, xviii; Deiss., BS, 148).
Paradise, the abode of the blessed dead: [[r:LUK.23.43|Luk 23:43]], [[r:2CO.12.4|2Co 12:4]], [[r:REV.2.7|Rev 2:7]].† (AS)

G3879.strongs: to bend beside, i.e. lean over (so as to peer within)
senses: to stoop to look: [[r:LUK.24.12|Luk 24:12]] (R, txt.), [[r:JHN.20.5|Jhn 20:5, 11]], Metaphorical (see Hort, Ja., in l), to look into: before εἰς, [[r:JAS.1.25|Jas 1:25]], [[r:1PE.1.12|1Pe 1:12]].† (AS)

G3849.root: from [[w:G3844]] and the middle voice of [[w:G0971]]
G3849.strongs: to force contrary to (nature), i.e. compel (by entreaty)
senses: prop., to force against nature or law.

G3808.root: neuter of a presumed derivative of [[w:G3816]]
senses: a little boy, a lad (in late and colloq. Gk. the word seems to be used with greater latitude and even to lose its dimin. force entirely; cf. [[r:TOB.6.2|Tob 6:2-3]], and see MM, xviii): [[r:JHN.6.9|Jhn 6:9.]]† SYN.: see: παῖς (AS)

G3888.root: from [[w:G3844]] and the middle voice of a derivative of [[w:G3454]]
G3888.strongs: to relate near, i.e. (by implication) encourage, console
senses: to comfort, console: with accusative of person(s), [[r:JHN.11.31|Jhn 11:31]], [[r:1TH.2.11|1Th 2:11 5:14]]; id. before περί, [[r:JHN.11.19|Jhn 11:19.]]† SYN.: παρακαλέω (AS)

παρά-κλητος, -ον (παρακαλεω), called to one's aid in a judicial cause (Dion. Cass.); hence, most frequently as subst., ὁ π., an advocate, pleader, intercessor (Dem., al.; so in Rabbinic lit., פְּרַקְלִיטָא), "a friend of the accused person, called to speak to his character, or otherwise enlist sympathy in his favour" (Field, Notes, 102). In NT, specif., ὁ π.,
of the Holy Spirit (AV, comforter; but see opp. with), [[r:JHN.14.16|Jhn 14:16, 26 15:26 16:7]] (cf. also Abbott, Essays, 86, 97; Deiss., LAE, 339 f.; MM, xviii; Westc., Jo., ii, 188) (AS)

G3828.strongs: every-tribal, i.e. heterogeneous ( being implied); Pamphylia, a region of Asia Minor

senses: παρ-αγγελία, -ας, ἡ (παραγγέλλω), an instruction, charge, com­mand: [[r:ACT.5.28|Act 5:28 16:24]], [[r:1TH.4.2|1Th 4:2]], [[r:1TI.1.5|1Ti 1:5 1:18]]. (In Xen., Polyb., of a military order.)† (AS)
to examine side by side, compare.
πανοικεί (Rec., LTr., -κί), adv. (πᾶς, οἶκος), a word rejected by strict Atticists, though found once in Plat. (Eryx., 392c); with all the household: [[r:ACT.16.34|Act 16:34.]]† (AS)

G3846.strongs: to throw alongside, i.e. (reflexively) to reach a place, or (figuratively) to liken
senses: to throw to or beside, as fodder to horses (Hom., al.).
to lay beside, compare (Hdt., Plat., al.): [[r:MRK.4.30|Mrk 4:30]], Rec.
Reflexive, to betake oneself, come near; of seamen, to cross over: εἰς Σάμον, [[r:ACT.20.15|Act 20:15.]]
παρα-πλέω to sail by or past: with accusative, [[r:ACT.20.16|Act 20:16.]]† (AS)

G3891.strongs: to be opposed to law, i.e. to transgress
senses: παρα-νομέω, ῶ to be a παράνομος, to transgress the law: [[r:ACT.23.3|Act 23:3.]]† (AS)
subject to suffering (R, mg., see M, Pr., 222) or destined to suffer (AV, R, txt.): [[r:ACT.26.23|Act 26:23.]]† (AS)

G3881.root: from [[w:G3844]] and the middle voice of [[w:G3004]] (in its original sense)
G3881.strongs: (specially), to lay one's course near, i.e. sail past
senses: later, of sailors, to sail past: with accusative, [[r:ACT.27.8|Act 27:8, 13]].† (AS)

G3867.strongs: to mispraise, i.e. recommend or advise (a different course)
senses: παρ-αινέω, -ω to exhort, advise: with accusative of person(s) and inf. (see Bl., § 72, 5; M, Pr., 205), [[r:ACT.27.22|Act 27:22]]; absol., before λέγων, [[r:ACT.27.9|Act 27:9.]]† (AS)

G3806.strongs: properly, suffering ("pathos"), i.e. (subjectively) a passion (especially concupiscence)
senses: that which befalls one, that which one suffers

a passive emotion or affection (esp. of violent emotion), a passion, passionate desire; in NT always in bad sense: [[r:COL.3.5|Col 3:5]]; π. ἀτιμίας, [[r:ROM.1.26|Rom 1:26]]; π. ἐπιθυμίας, [[r:1TH.4.5|1Th 4:5.]]† SYN.: π. = πάθημα, exc. that πάθημα is the more concrete and particular. In NT usage, π. represents the passive, ungoverned aspect of evil desire, as opposite to ἐπιθυμία, which is the active and also the more comprehensive term (see Tr., Syn., LXXxvii); cf. also ὄρεξις (AS)

G3810.strongs: a trainer, i.e. teacher or (by implication) discipliner
senses: a corrector, one who disciplines (cf. Ho, l.with): [[r:HEB.12.9|Heb 12:9.]]† (AS)

In later writers, an overstepping; metaphorically, transgression (Plut., al.): [[r:ROM.4.15|Rom 4:15 5:14]], [[r:HEB.2.2|Heb 2:2 9:15]]; τ. νόμου, [[r:ROM.2.23|Rom 2:23]]; ἐν π., [[r:1TI.2.14|1Ti 2:14]]; τ. παραβάσεων χάριν, [[r:GAL.3.19|Gal 3:19]] SYN.: see: ἁμαρτία (AS)
one who stands beside, the warrior who stands by the charioteer (of. παραβαίνω, 1).
Later, as following inattention, disobedience: [[r:ROM.5.19|Rom 5:19]], [[r:2CO.10.6|2Co 10:6]], [[r:HEB.2.2|Heb 2:2]] (cf. παρακούω, and see Tr., Syn., § lxvi).† (AS)

G3804.strongs: something undergone, i.e. hardship or pain; subjectively, an emotion or influence
senses: that which befalls one, a suffering, affliction: pl., [[r:ROM.8.18|Rom 8:18]], [[r:2CO.1.6|2Co 1:6-7]], [[r:COL.1.24|Col 1:24]], [[r:2TI.3.11|2Ti 3:11]], [[r:HEB.2.10|Heb 2:10 10:32]], [[r:1PE.5.9|1Pe 5:9]]; of Christ's sufferings: τὰ εἰς Χ., [[r:1PE.1.11|1Pe 1:11]]; τ. Χριστσῦ, [[r:1PE.5.1|1Pe 5:1]]; id. as shared by Christians, [[r:2CO.1.5|2Co 1:5]], [[r:PHP.3.10|Php 3:10]], [[r:1PE.4.13|1Pe 4:13]].
a passive emotion, affection, passion: [[r:GAL.5.24|Gal 5:24]]; τ. ἀμαρτιῶν, [[r:ROM.7.5|Rom 7:5]]
= τὸ πάσχειν, an enduring or suffering: with genitive obj., [[r:HEB.2.9|Heb 2:9.]]† SYN.: see: πάθος (AS)

G3873.strongs: to lie near, i.e. be at hand (figuratively, be prompt or easy)
senses: παρά-κειμαι to lie beside, be near, be present: [[r:ROM.7.18|Rom 7:18, 21]].† (AS)

G3863.strongs: to stimulate alongside, i.e. excite to rivalry

G3807.root: from [[w:G3816]] and a reduplicated form of [[w:G0071]]
G3807.strongs: a boy-leader, i.e. a servant whose office it was to take the children to school; (by implication, (figuratively) a tutor ("pædagogue"))
senses: (παῖς, ἄγω), a guide, guardian, trainer of boys, a tutor (disting. from διδάσκαλος, Xen., Lac., 3, 1), usually a trusty slave: opposite to πατήρ, [[r:1CO.4.15|1Co 4:15]]; figuratively, of the Law, π. εἰς Χριστόν, [[r:GAL.3.24|Gal 3:24-25.]]† (AS)
(παῖς), prop., to play as a child, hence, generally, to play (as with singing and dancing): [[r:1CO.10.7|1Co 10:7]] (LXX) (cf. ἐμ-παίζω).† (AS)

G3887.strongs: to stay near, i.e. remain (literally, tarry; or figuratively, be permanent, persevere)
senses: παρα-μένω to remain beside or near: [[r:HEB.7.23|Heb 7:23]], [[r:JAS.1.25|Jas 1:25]]; of remaining alive, [[r:1CO.16.6|1Co 16:6]] (WH, κατα-), [[r:PHP.1.25|Php 1:25]] (cf. συμ-παραμένω).† (AS)

G3841.strongs: the all-ruling, i.e. God (as absolute and universal sovereign)

senses: in cl., chiefly in bad sense, knavish, crafty: [[r:2CO.12.16|2Co 12:16]];

G3809.strongs: tutorage, i.e. education or training; by implication, disciplinary correction

senses: (πάλλω, to sway) wrestling, hence, generally, fight, contest: figuratively, of the spiritual combat of Christians, [[r:EPH.6.12|Eph 6:12.]]† (AS)
an exhortation, persuasion, encouragement: [[r:PHP.2.1|Php 2:1]] (cf. Plat., Legg., vi, 773 E, al.; see Lft. and ICC, Phi., l.with).
assuagement, abatement, hence, consolation (Wis, l.with, and frequently in cl.).† (AS)

G3897.root: neuter of a compound of [[w:G3844]] and the base of [[w:G4139]] (as adverb)
senses: παρα-πλήσιος, -α, -ον (Hdt., Plat., al.; also -ος, -ον, Thuc., Polyb.), coming near, nearly resembling. Neut. -ον, adverbially, = ίως, in a way nearly resembling: with dative, [[r:PHP.2.27|Php 2:27.]]† (AS)

G3851.root: from [[w:G3844]] and the middle voice of [[w:G1011]]
senses: παρα-βολεύομαι = cl. παραβάλλομαι ([[r:2MA.14.38|2Ma 14:38]]), to expose oneself to danger, hazard one's life: with dative ref., τ. ψυχῇ (see M, Pr., 64), [[r:PHP.2.30|Php 2:30]] (Rec. παραβουλ-). Cited by Deiss., LAE, 84, 120.† παρα-βουλεύομαι, to consult amiss, or perh. (see LS, see word), a vulg. form of παρα-βολ- (which see): [[r:PHP.2.30|Php 2:30]], Rec.† (AS)

παρα-δια-τριβή, -ῆς, ἡ useless wrangling: seel. in Rec. for διαπαρατριβή (which see), [[r:1TI.6.5|1Ti 6:5.]]† δια-παρα-τριβή, -ῆς, ἡ (παρατριβή, friction, irritation) mutual irritation (Field, Notes, 211), wrangling: [[r:1TI.6.5|1Ti 6:5]] (Rec. παραδιατριβή).† (AS)
παρα-θήκη, -ης, ἡ (παρατίθημι), a deposit or trust: [[r:1TI.6.20|1Ti 6:20]], [[r:2TI.1.12|2Ti 1:12 1:14]] (for exx. of this form, see MM, Exp., iii, xviii).† (AS)

G3898.strongs: in a manner near by, i.e. (figuratively) similarly

senses: παρα-πικρασμός, -οῦ, ἁ (παραπικραίνω) provocation: ἐν τῷ π. (Heb. at Meribah), [[r:HEB.3.8|Heb 3:8, 15]]" (LXX).† (AS)

G3893.strongs: to embitter alongside, i.e. (figuratively) to exasperate
senses: παρα-πικραίνω to embitter, provoke: absol. (yet sc. τ. θεόν, cf. [[r:PSA.106.7|Psa 106:7]], [[r:EZK.2.5|Eze 2:5-8]], al., and with τὸν θ. added, [[r:PSA.5.4|Psa 5:4]], [[r:EZK.20.21|Eze 20:21]], al.), [[r:HEB.3.16|Heb 3:16]] (cf. παραπικρασμός).† (AS)

G3895.strongs: to fall aside, i.e. (figuratively) to apostatize
senses: most frequently (Hdt., Thuc., al.), to fall in one's way, befall.
to fall into or in (before εἰς, Polyb.; with dative, 2Mac, l.with).
to fall away (En, Wis, ll. with; in Polyb., with genitive): absol., [[r:HEB.6.6|Heb 6:6.]]

G3856.strongs: to show alongside (the public), i.e. expose to infamy
G3856.kjv: make a public example, put to an open shame
senses: παρα-δειγματίζω (δείκνυμι), to set forth as an example; in bad sense, to put to open shame: [[r:HEB.6.6|Heb 6:6]] (Polyb., Plut., al.).† (AS)

(πᾶς + ἄγυρας = ἀγορά), prop., a national festal assembly in honour of a god; hence, generally, any festal assembly: [[r:HEB.12.23|Heb 12:23]] (for exx. in π., see MM, xviii).† SYN.: ἐκκλησία (which see), συναγωγή (AS)

G3883.strongs: transmutation (of phase or orbit), i.e. (figuratively) fickleness
senses: παρ-αλλαγή, -ῆς, ἡ (παραλλάσσω), in various senses (LS, see word), change: [[r:JAS.1.17|Jas 1:17.]]† (AS)
